evidence: Cell proliferation was examined by Edu staining
paragraphs: Edu is used as the staining-based assay for examining cell proliferation in H9c2 cells under serum deprivation. The study assesses proliferation as part of its analysis of PTEN-related effects; PTEN knockdown was reported to increase cell proliferation.

evidence: In this study, we used H9c2 cells cultured under serum deprivation to simulate the apoptosis process of myocardial infarction.
As a result, we observed that serum deprivation in H9c2 cells increased PTEN expression.
PTEN knockdown experiment using siRNA inhibited serum deprivation-induced cell apoptosis, ROS production, and DNA damage
paragraphs: Serum deficiency is used as the experimental serum-deprivation condition in H9c2 cells to simulate the apoptosis process associated with myocardial infarction. Under this condition, the authors investigate PTEN-related cytotoxicity and report increased PTEN expression, along with apoptosis, ROS production, and DNA damage that were reduced by PTEN knockdown.
